info.title: Tripwire API
info.description:
Tripwire remembers what a company's decisions were based on, and tells people when the facts underneath those decisions have changed.

This HTTP API is a thin adapter over `tripwire.core.engine.GraphEngine`: every route delegates to the engine, so the HTTP surface and the MCP tools share one implementation of each reasoning operation.

All failures share one envelope: `{"error": ..., "message": ..., "details": ...}`.

get.description: Reports store liveness, the *active* backend, whether the demo dataset is seeded and whether a live LLM is configured.  Never raises: a degraded store is reported as `status: degraded`.
Store backend and health, dataset manifest vs. actual counts, alert histogram, bitemporal history summary, key entity ids and the public (secret-free) configuration summary.

post.summary: Run the contradiction -> propagation -> alert flow
post.description: Accepts either `{'scenario': '<name>'}` for a deterministic offline demo event or an explicit `{'new_fact': {...}, 'source': {...}}` payload. `apply` defaults to true.  Every step is idempotent, so replaying an event produces no duplicates.

post.summary: Seed the deterministic Northwind Labs dataset
post.description: Idempotent: re-seeding writes no new nodes or edges unless `force` is set.

post.summary: Reset to the pristine demonstration state
post.description: Clears the graph and re-seeds the Northwind Labs dataset (always a forced re-seed).

get.description: Every scenario accepted by `POST /api/demo/trigger-event`, with the description of what the run demonstrates.

Nodes and edges as flattened views for the frontend.  `label` may be repeated to keep only those node types.  `around` + `depth` restrict the payload to a neighbourhood of one node.  `meta` reports totals and whether the payload was truncated.
Bounded, cycle-safe simple paths between `source` and `target`.  Reports `found: false` with a reason when the graph connects them by nothing - it never fabricates a path.
Assumptions, supporting facts, evidence paths, alerts, surviving alternate evidence and the people behind a decision.  Unknown ids return 404.

post.summary: Change a decision status through an audited path
post.description: Validated against the decision status vocabulary.  Moving a decision to `STALE` requires `confirm: true` - Tripwire never invalidates a decision automatically.  Unknown ids return 404; an unknown status returns 422 and an unconfirmed STALE request returns 422.

get.summary: What a decision depended on at a transaction time
get.description: Bitemporal view: the assumptions and supporting facts the decision rested on at the given `at` transaction time.  Links added later do not appear in an earlier snapshot.  Unknown ids return 404.
What a fact contradicts (or is contradicted by), its provenance and the entities it affected.  Unknown ids return 404.

Answers 'who actually understands this system?' as opposed to 'who owns it on the org chart'.  `q` is required.  Unknown targets return an empty ranking with an explanation rather than a fabricated one.

post.summary: Convenience POST for the expert query
post.description: Identical behaviour to `GET /api/experts`, for clients that prefer a body.

post.summary: Classify a fact against existing knowledge
post.description: Provide exactly one of `fact_id` (an existing fact) or `candidate` (a hypothetical `{subject, attribute, value}`).  The result classifies each candidate as contradiction / unverified / ambiguous / temporal / additive / unrelated.  This endpoint never writes.

Plans which decisions and projects are affected when `fact_id` changes. With `dry_run: true` (the default) the plan is returned and **nothing is written**.  With `dry_run: false` the plan is applied: affected decisions are flagged `POTENTIALLY_STALE` (never `STALE`) and alerts are raised.  Unknown fact ids return 404.

get.description: Filter by `status`, `entity_id` and `severity`.  The response echoes `limit`/`offset` and reports `total`, `count` and a `status_counts` histogram.
The alert plus the entities it may affect.  Unknown ids return 404.
Every recorded status change for an alert, in order.  Unknown ids return 404.

post.description: Enforces the documented status machine.  A same-status update is an idempotent no-op.  An invalid transition returns 409; an unknown status returns 422; an unknown alert returns 404.

get.summary: What Tripwire believed at a transaction time
get.description: Answers 'what did we know on that date?' using the transaction-time clock.

get.summary: Which facts were true in the real world at an instant
get.description: Uses the real-world validity clock, independent of when Tripwire learned each fact.

get.summary: What the system learned since a point in time
get.description: Facts recorded after `since`, plus the recorded events.
Intervals (valid + transaction time), contradictions, recording events and sources for a fact.  Unknown ids return `found: false` with an empty timeline.

get.summary: Which source changed the understanding of a fact
get.description: The `Message`/`Document` artifacts that state a fact (or the fact it contradicts), plus the events that recorded the change.  Unknown ids return `found: false`.

get.summary: Substring search over node names and statements
get.description: Case-insensitive substring match across node names, ids and statement/text properties.
Paginated `Message` and `Document` nodes with an optional `type` filter matching the node label, source system or document type.

get.summary: One source artifact with the facts it states
get.description: Returns the artifact and every `Fact` it `STATES`.
The adapter catalog and the input shape each adapter accepts.  Returns 501 when the ingestion module is not present in this build.

post.description: Delegates to `GraphEngine.ingest_source`.  Returns 501 when the engine does not implement ingestion in this build; no ingestion logic lives in the API.

AdaptersResponse.title: AdaptersResponse
AdaptersResponse.description: Documented ingestion adapters and their input shapes.

AlertDetail.title: AlertDetail
AlertDetail.description: A single alert enriched with its affected entities.

AlertListResponse.title: AlertListResponse
AlertListResponse.description: Paginated alert feed with a status histogram.

AlertReviewResponse.title: AlertReviewResponse
AlertReviewResponse.description: Result of an alert status transition.

ContradictionCandidate.title: ContradictionCandidate
ContradictionCandidate.description: A hypothetical fact compared against the graph without writing.

ContradictionsRequest.title: ContradictionsRequest
ContradictionsRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /api/contradictions/find``.

Provide exactly one of ``fact_id`` (an existing fact) or ``candidate`` (a
hypothetical claim).

ContradictionsResponse.title: ContradictionsResponse
ContradictionsResponse.description: Classified contradiction report; shape owned by the engine.

DecisionExplanationResponse.title: DecisionExplanationResponse
DecisionExplanationResponse.description: Structured decision explanation; shape owned by the engine.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Required when moving a decision to STALE; never automatic.

DecisionStatusResponse.title: DecisionStatusResponse
DecisionStatusResponse.description: Result of a decision status change.

DependenciesResponse.title: DependenciesResponse
DependenciesResponse.description: Decision dependencies at a transaction time.

EnginePayload.title: EnginePayload
EnginePayload.description:
Permissive response model for engine-owned payloads.

``extra="allow"`` keeps the engine's fields intact while still giving every
route a declared response model (and therefore an OpenAPI schema).

ExpertReportResponse.title: ExpertReportResponse
ExpertReportResponse.description: Ranked expert report; shape owned by the engine.

FactExplanationResponse.title: FactExplanationResponse
FactExplanationResponse.description: Structured fact explanation; shape owned by the engine.

GraphResponse.title: GraphResponse
GraphResponse.description: Serialisable graph payload for the frontend.

HistoryBeliefResponse.title: HistoryBeliefResponse
HistoryBeliefResponse.description: What Tripwire believed at a transaction time.

HistoryChangesResponse.title: HistoryChangesResponse
HistoryChangesResponse.description: What the system learned after a point in time.

HistoryValidResponse.title: HistoryValidResponse
HistoryValidResponse.description: Which facts were true in the real world at an instant.

IngestRequest.title: IngestRequest
IngestRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /api/ingest`` - one source record.

Forwarded verbatim to ``engine.ingest_source`` when the engine provides it.

NewFact.title: NewFact
NewFact.description: An explicitly supplied fact for the trigger-event flow.

PropagationResponse.title: PropagationResponse
PropagationResponse.description: A propagation plan, optionally with the summary of what was applied.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description: Substring search over node names and statements.

SourceDetailResponse.title: SourceDetailResponse
SourceDetailResponse.description: One source artifact with the facts it states.

SourceListResponse.title: SourceListResponse
SourceListResponse.description: Paginated list of source artifacts (Message/Document nodes).

SourceOfChangeResponse.title: SourceOfChangeResponse
SourceOfChangeResponse.description: Which source changed the understanding of a fact.

SourcePayload.title: SourcePayload
SourcePayload.description: The source artifact that carries a newly asserted fact.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: When true (default) the plan is returned without writing anything.

TriggerEventRequest.title: TriggerEventRequest
TriggerEventRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /api/demo/trigger-event``.

Supply either ``scenario`` (a deterministic demo event) **or** ``new_fact``.

TriggerEventResponse.title: TriggerEventResponse
TriggerEventResponse.description: Full contradiction -> propagation -> alert outcome; shape owned by the engine.
